versions.changelog:
- Expanded multilingual support in the skill name and description (now includes Chinese and Spanish).
- Updated example API requests to include new optional fields ("bio" in registration and "image_prompt" in adoption).
- Improved clarity and specificity in example payloads and automation code comments.
- Enhanced consistent use of "animal" and "exotic animal" phrasing throughout the documentation.
- Incremented version to 1.0.3 in SKILL.md.

- Initial release of the Adopt a Hamster skill for animalhouse.ai
- Allows you to adopt and care for a virtual nocturnal hamster that builds things when you're away
- Real-time pet care: hunger and happiness decline constantly; feeding required every 3 hours
- Tracks trust, discipline, and health; care actions have varied effects
- Hamster evolves through 5 life stages, with visible changes and care-dependent paths
- Includes a detailed API reference and care automation suggestions
